text:
alex.sales: Heads-up  PrimeBank (EU-regulated) wants a 2-week BYOK POC. Must-haves: keys generated in-customer HSM (no-export), EU-only egress, rotation cadence requested 45d (they asked if 90d is possible), audit logs forwarded to their Splunk, and option to run Dedicated or Private. Any immediate blockers?
trina.solutions: Quick Q: do they expect Redwood to manage rotation or do they want to initiate it? Also confirm escrow policy preference.
pmurray.bank: We'll manage rotation but Redwood must support atomic rebind and accept both old+new keys during a 12-48h overlap. No Redwood key escrow unless court-ordered. FIPS attestation preferred.
raj.crypto: We support born-in-HSM flows for CloudHSM, Luna, Utimaco. For strict no-export the customer must either (a) expose a PKCS#11 endpoint we can call over peered network, or (b) perform import via their HSM console and provide wrapped CMK. 45d rotation is okay but increases coordination; ops surcharge may apply if cadence <90d. Latency: what's the p99 requirement?
alex.sales: They want p95 ~70ms, p99 <180ms. Peak KMS ops ~30/sec.
trina.solutions: Networking checklist for customer: CIDR allowlist, DNS name for proxy, mTLS client cert for Redwood service account, test endpoint and a short bastion window. Send these tests to them:
```bash
# from customer bastion -> proposed proxy
openssl s_client -connect kms-proxy.eu-west-1.redwood-internal:443 -servername kms.prime.internal -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/prime-root.pem
```
raj.crypto: Also request PKCS#11 module version, HSM firmware, supported key types (AES-256-GCM, RSA-3072, ECDSA P-384), and vendor import API docs. If they require firmware attestation, that adds ~1 week to onboarding.
pmurray.bank: We'll provide vendor docs and a 2-hour bastion slot Tuesday 09:30 CET. We'll also attach our DR escrow policy (sealed and only accessible under court order).
legal-bot: Engineering/legal to review escrow wording. Also confirm whether 45d triggers an ops surcharge and any indemnity concerns.
pricing-bot: Note: BYOK with private HSM proxy has a one-time integration fee and a private deployment monthly premium. Dedicated pricing differs (lower unit price, committed term). I'll post an estimated delta after ops confirm rotation cadence.
runbook-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/sales/primebank-byo-poc  includes connectivity checklist, rotation playbook template, and contact matrix. :white_check_mark:
trina.solutions: Action items: 1) @raj.crypto produce vendor compatibility + firmware/attestation impacts. 2) @pricing-bot draft Dedicated vs Private delta incl. potential <90d surcharge. 3) @pmurray.bank send CIDRs, bastion window, and vendor docs. 4) @legal-bot review escrow clause text.
alex.sales: Thanks team  goal is to kick off preflight Tuesday and have a draft SOW by Wednesday. :rocket:
